description.text: IDTA 02015 CCType — Control Component Type (Interfaces, Skills, Errors), ARSO-flattened.
Mandatory top-level container, always present and always empty.
Mandatory top-level container for all Skill entries.
A named skill.
The skill's own semantic identifier URI: what it does (lab namespace convention, enforced via SHACL sh:pattern).
One command of a skill: the action that calls it, its Operation, and what it runs.
The AID action (arso:InterfaceSMC/InteractionMetadata/actions/{action}) that calls the command; in the short form, the action that starts the skill.
Operation — the invocable Operation of a command (named like it), or in the short form of a skill (named like the skill).
What a command runs (or a branch, or the body of a conditional step): steps in the order of their Order.
One node of the flow.
The node's identifier, unique in its command.
Step, parallel, decision or conditional.
What a step, a branch or an output is called for a person; of a Binding, the input of the step's skill it is about.
The position among its siblings, from 0; it decides the order, not the place in the collection.
The skill a step runs, the whole of it: running it is its Start, and its other commands are what ends it early.
What the inputs of the step's skill are handed.
One input of the step's skill (Name): a constant (Value) or a variable of the command's Operation (SourceElement).
What a step, a branch or an output is called for a person; of a Binding, the input of the step's skill it is about.
A constant: what a Binding hands to the input (the value as it runs), or what a Condition compares with.
The variable of the command's Operation that is handed down to the input, or that a Condition looks at.
The input itself: the variable of the Start Operation of the step's skill.

For primitive skills: Requires (precondition), Ensures (postcondition) or After (open-loop duration), Invariant, Timeout.
The precondition: what has to hold when the skill starts.
The postcondition: the skill has succeeded when it holds (a sensor ends it).
The open-loop duration: the skill has succeeded when it has passed, in seconds (a time ends it).
What has to hold all the while the skill runs.
The longest the skill may run, a duration.
Present only on asynchronous skills of the short form.

Numeric error code identifying this error.
